Time for different time zones

Product·by @tar_uniqueee·2026-09-03·inspora page·original post

What it is

Dark world-clock app with a scrubbable 24h tick ruler: dragging shifts time globally, all city rows roll odometer clocks, an orange band shows the scrubbed window with live duration, statuses (night/working) update; rows can be drag-reordered.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-12%
Resting: tick ruler with red NOW marker; 4 city rows (Warsaw, SF -9H, NY -6H, New Delhi +3H30M) with day label, status icon, HH:MM.
12-30%
Drag: ticks stream horizontally; orange band grows right of NOW labeled '-1H 15M'; row times roll like odometers; statuses flip.
30-55%
Band widens to '-6H 40M'..'-7H'; day labels flip to YESTERDAY for cities crossing midnight.
55-75%
Band settles ~-9H; final scrubbed times and updated status icons.
75-92%
Release: ruler springs back to NOW, band collapses; times roll back up; statuses revert.
92-100%
Resting state restored. One frame shows New Delhi dragged above New York - row reorder gesture.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a dark world-clock app with a scrubbable 24h tick ruler. Dragging horizontally shifts time globally - every city row rolls its odometer clock, an orange selection band shows the scrubbed window with live duration, day/status labels update across midnight. Release springs back to NOW. Rows can also be drag-reordered vertically.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark UI (near-black bg, white text). Top: horizontal tick ruler (hour ticks, minor/major) with a red NOW marker fixed center. Right of NOW while scrubbing: orange selection band with a mono duration label ("-6H 40M"). Below: city rows (Warsaw, SF -9H, NY -6H, New Delhi +3H30M) each with name, offset badge, day chip (TODAY/YESTERDAY), status icon (night/working), and HH:MM rolling clock.

## Motion spec
Pattern: gesture-driven scrub + spring release; plus vertical drag-reorder.
- Horizontal drag: ruler translateX 1:1 under the finger; band grows from NOW with live duration label; all rows' digits roll continuously (~200ms roll cadence); day chips flip to YESTERDAY as cities cross midnight; status icons flip with working hours.
- Release: ruler springs back to NOW (stiffness ~170, damping ~22, ~500ms settle); band collapses; digits roll back up; statuses revert.
- Vertical drag on a row: row lifts (scale 1.02, shadow), siblings slide aside with layout animations, drop reorders.

## Calibration
- Scrub is 1:1 and immediate - any smoothing on the ruler itself kills the directness; smoothing lives only in the digit rolls.
- Release spring ~500ms settle with a soft overshoot; stiffness 170 / damping 22 is the reference feel.
- Digit rolls ~200ms, always rolling in the direction of travel.

## Reduced motion
Ruler still scrubs 1:1 (it is positional, not decorative); digits swap without rolling; release uses a 200ms ease-out tween instead of spring.

## Don't miss
- NOW marker stays pinned; the ruler moves under it - never move the marker.
- The band is anchored at NOW and grows in the drag direction, labeled live.
- Reorder and time-scrub are separate gestures on separate axes; do not let horizontal jitter reorder rows.
